The '''Garena Premier League 2013 Championship''' was the final event of the [[Garena Premier League]] ('''GPL''') 2013 season, held offline in Taiwan on August 29, 2013. The tournament featured a total prize pool of $52,000 {{Abbr/USD}} and brought together the champions of the Spring and Summer splits to determine the overall GPL champion for the year. The Championship was contested as a single best-of-three match. [[Taipei Assassins]] qualified by winning the Spring split, while [[ahq e-Sports Club]] earned their spot as the Summer split champion. The winner of the match was crowned the GPL champion for the 2013 season.
